urls.title: URLs to audit
urls.description: One or more pages to audit (https://example.com). Each URL costs one audit.

maxPages.title: Max pages to crawl
maxPages.description: 1 = audit only the given URLs. Above 1 = follow internal links of each start URL (same domain) until this many pages are audited. Max 50.

sameDomainOnly.title: Stay on the same domain when crawling
sameDomainOnly.description: When crawling (maxPages > 1), follow only links on the start URL's host.
